title: melissa rotundifolia
intro: Melissa rotundifolia, commonly known as round-leaved balm or round-leaf lemon balm, is a perennial herb belonging to the Lamiaceae family. The plant is rich in health benefits, which include its ability to calm the nervous system, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and stress. The therapeutic actions of Melissa rotundifolia include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties, which make it useful in treating various skin conditions, wounds, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include rosmarinic acid, ursolic acid, and melissic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
